issues.explanation: No change to the entity.members route is shown, so the required route-level manager gate cannot be verified; only Members::mount enforces it.
Livewire inputs use inline $this->validate([...]) instead of the project-required #[Validate] attributes on public properties.
Domain writes (invite create, membership firstOrCreate/update/delete) happen directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* classes.
Server-context selectedMembershipId is client-writable without #[Locked]; it is mitigated by scoping every lookup to entity->memberships()->findOrFail.
Members page route gate is not evidenced; Livewire mount authorization still blocks data, so impact is limited to a potentially renderable shell.

conventions.evidence: Members.php:72-74 inline validate without #[Validate]; direct EntityInvite/EntityMembership writes with no app/Actions/*; selectedMembershipId not #[Locked] vs PendingInvites.php:352 separated is #[Locked]

readability.evidence: Members.php:306-324 selectedMembership/managerCount helpers; PendingInvites.php:437-444 inviteeInvite helper; clear names and small methods

requirements.evidence: Members.php:99-179 sendInvite validates, checks member/pending, handles UniqueConstraintViolationException, rate-limits, queues EntityInviteMail; PendingInvites.php:355-420 accept/decline with 403/expired/idempotent/firstOrCreate/redirect; missing entity.members route gate in diff

scope.evidence: Diff touches only invites, members modal, switcher/onboarding placement, mail, lang, docs/tests; Dashboard.php:30 and dashboard.blade.php:959-963 only hide members UI from non-managers

security.evidence: Members.php:94,101,184,202,222,312 authorize; PendingInvites.php:441 abort_unless email match 403; validation + RateLimiter + scoped findOrFail + {{ }} escaping; no secrets in public props

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Entity::invites, scopes pending/forEmail, firstOrCreate, RateLimiter, x-mail::message theme; no new service layers or duplication

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/InvitesTest.php:1200-1584 and MembersTest.php:1634-2157 cover model, mail EN/pt-BR, accept/decline, tamper/locked, 403, race, rate-limit, modals, placement

review.summary: Invite-only membership is fully implemented with model, mail, Livewire flows, UI placement and extensive tests. Missing route-level gate evidence and Livewire convention deviations (no #[Validate], no Actions, unlocked selection id) require changes before merging.
